titleVi: Tội phạm, Công lý & Hệ thống Tư pháp Hình sự
themeSummaryVi: Hệ thống thuật ngữ tư pháp C2 tinh vi: tội danh, phán quyết, tình tiết giảm nhẹ, dẫn độ và các mức án hình sự.

schemaItems.definitionEn: To officially absolve someone from blame or a criminal charge after conclusive proof.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Minh oan, tuyên bố vô tội và giải phóng khỏi mọi cáo buộc hình sự.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Fresh post-conviction DNA evidence completely exonerated the wrongly imprisoned defendant.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A luminous figure breaking free from heavy iron shackles into radiant open space.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: To make someone appear guilty of a crime or wrongdoing.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: Dark constriction bands wrapping tightly around an entrapped silhouette.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Serving to lessen the apparent seriousness or guilt of a crime (mitigating).
schemaItems.definitionVi: Mang tính giảm nhẹ (hoàn cảnh xoa dịu mức độ nghiêm trọng của hành vi vi phạm).
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The magistrate imposed a suspended sentence on account of undeniable extenuating circumstances.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A heavy tilted scale gently swinging back toward level equilibrium under a warm protective light.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Made more severe, violent, or heinous through deliberate malice.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A harsh spike abruptly overloading a fragile scale with jagged fiery shockwaves.

schemaItems.definitionEn: The tendency of a convicted criminal to relapse into habitual criminal behavior.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tình trạng tái phạm tội sau khi thụ án; thói quen ngựa quen đường cũ.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Rigorous vocational rehabilitation programmes in penitentiaries drastically reduce the rate of recidivism.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A cyclical recursive orbital loop endlessly dragging a wandering particle back into an obsidian vortex.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: The restoration of someone to a useful and constructive place in society.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A straight ascending golden vector breaking through a recursive ring.

schemaItems.definitionEn: To imprison, confine, or lock someone up in a penitentiary.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tống giam, giam giữ trong nhà tù kiên cố.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Following the landmark ruling, the ringleader was incarcerated in maximum security for twenty years.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Heavy lattice force-bars slamming shut and isolating a particle inside an impenetrable core.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: The conditional early release of a prisoner prior to completing full sentence.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A sliding laser barrier parting smoothly to permit controlled forward passage.

schemaItems.definitionEn: To reject or void an official verdict by legal judicial procedure.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Hủy bỏ, bác bỏ hoàn toàn một bản án/phán quyết sai lệch.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The Court of Appeal moved to quash the conviction after forensic falsification was exposed.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A massive crystalline gavel striking down and shattering a flawed stone tablet into dust.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: To confirm or support a legal decision which has been questioned.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: Reinforcing columns rising up to buttress and lock a foundation stone in place.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Utterly odious, wicked, and shocking to all moral sensibilities.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tàn độc, ghê tởm, cực kỳ dã man đến mức rúng động lương tri.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The judge described the premeditated arson as the most heinous infraction to enter his courtroom.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Corrosive black lightning tendrils tearing violently across a peaceful geometric grid.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Denoting a sin or offense that is minor and excusable.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A tiny ripple dissolving softly into calm still water.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: Conditions that make a criminal act appear less severe and warrant leniency.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Tình tiết giảm nhẹ (hoàn cảnh xoa dịu mức án).
collocationPairs.example: He was let off with a caution on account of verifiable extenuating circumstances.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A failure of a court of law to attain justice, typically sentencing an innocent party.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Án oan sai; sự đổ vỡ của công lý do sai lệch tố tụng.
collocationPairs.example: The wrongful imprisonment of the Guildford Four stands as a notorious miscarriage of justice.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A judicial sentence requiring imprisonment or detention in an institution.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Bản án phạt tù giam (bắt buộc phải thụ án trong trại giam).
collocationPairs.example: Given the gravity of the assault, the judge handed down an immediate custodial sentence.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A prison sentence that will only be served if the convict reoffends within a set duration.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Án treo (chỉ phải đi tù nếu tái phạm trong thời gian thử thách).
collocationPairs.example: He was handed a two-year suspended sentence accompanied by rigorous community service.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: To legally overturn or declare void an earlier court determination.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Tuyên hủy bản án / bác bỏ phán quyết sai phạm.
collocationPairs.example: The appellate panel unanimously voted to quash the verdict and ordered a complete retrial.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A statutory prison term of life imprisonment legally mandated without judicial discretion.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Bản án chung thân bắt buộc theo luật định.
collocationPairs.example: Conviction for first-degree premeditated murder carries an automatic mandatory life sentence.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: To order someone under penalty of law to appear and give sworn testimony in court.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Tống đạt trát đòi nhân chứng ra hầu tòa đối chất.
collocationPairs.example: The special prosecutor moved to subpoena a key witness who had fled overseas.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: Tracking an offenders geographic whereabouts using an ankle tag or tracking device.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Giám sát điện tử qua vòng đeo chân định vị.
collocationPairs.example: As a strict condition of bail, the suspect was placed under continuous electronic monitoring.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Tội khai man có tuyên thệ trước tòa
domainSortItems.clueEn: The offense of willfully telling an untruth in a court after taking an oath.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Tội tham ô tài sản được ủy thác
domainSortItems.clueEn: Theft or misappropriation of funds placed in ones trust or belonging to ones employer.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Trát hầu tòa bắt buộc của thẩm phán
domainSortItems.clueEn: A writ issuing from a court ordering a person to attend and present evidence.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Sự dẫn độ tội phạm quốc tế
domainSortItems.clueEn: The official surrender of an alleged criminal by one state to another.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Chế độ quản chế theo dõi ngoài xã hội
domainSortItems.clueEn: The release of an offender from detention subject to a period of good behavior under supervision.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Đặc xá tha tù trước thời hạn
domainSortItems.clueEn: The conditional release of a prisoner before the sentence expires on promise of good conduct.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Bản cáo trạng luận tội chính thức
domainSortItems.clueEn: A formal charge or accusation of a serious crime issued by a grand jury.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Khoa học giám định đạn đạo vũ khí
domainSortItems.clueEn: The forensic study of the mechanics of projectiles, firearms, and bullet trajectories.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Bồi thường tổn thất cho nạn nhân
domainSortItems.clueEn: Recompense for injury or loss paid directly by the perpetrator to the victim.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Tỷ lệ tái phạm tội sau mãn hạn
domainSortItems.clueEn: The relapse of an individual into criminal activity after correctional punishment.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Formal criminal accusation / Electrical energy / Sudden frontal assault
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Cáo buộc hình sự / Điện tích tích lũy / Xung phong đột kích
sentences: The prosecutor formally filed a murder ___ against the apprehended suspect.
The battery was completely drained and refused to hold an electric ___.
The cavalry captain ordered a furious frontal ___ against enemy fortifications.
nuanceNotes: Military tactics: aggressive advance under fire.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: To present a formal court answer / To beg passionately
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Nhận tội trước tòa (plead guilty) / Biện hộ van nài / Đưa ra lý lẽ
sentences: Counsel advised the defendant to ___ guilty in exchange for sentencing leniency.
The victim could only tearfully ___ for mercy as the armed intruders surrounded him.
She tried to ___ ignorance of the company's fraudulent offshore tax shelters.
nuanceNotes: Judicial proceeding: entering a formal plea of guilt or innocence.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Judicial punishment order / Grammatical syntactic clause
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Mức án hình sự / Câu hoàn chỉnh ngữ pháp / Tuyên án
sentences: The presiding judge handed down a mandatory life ___ without possibility of parole.
Every declarative ___ in the academic essay must possess an explicit subject and predicate.
The tribunal opted to ___ the disgraced executive to five years of community labor.
nuanceNotes: Penology: penal sanction decreed by a magistrate.
Verb transitivity: the judicial act of decreeing punishment.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Violation of legal duty / Gap smashed in a barrier
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Vi phạm nghĩa vụ hợp đồng / Chọc thủng phòng tuyến / Phá vỡ an ninh
sentences: Leaking the confidential client ledger constituted an actionable ___ of fiduciary trust.
Artillery fire succeeded in blasting a massive ___ in the fortress battlements.
Cybersecurity investigators confirmed a severe data ___ affecting millions of accounts.
nuanceNotes: Contract law: violation of binding covenant.
Siege warfare: physical fracture in protective enclosure.
Information security: unauthorized penetration of firewall.

morphologicalFamilies.meaningVi: Buộc tội, đổ trách nhiệm hình sự
morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: He ___ (incriminate) himself beyond doubt by unwittingly providing the detectives with a fabricated alibi.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Incriminate oneself (tự chuốc vạ vào thân, tự cung cấp bằng chứng buộc tội chính mình).

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The newly unearthed forensic analysis led to the complete ___ (exonerate) of the two co-defendants.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Exoneration là danh từ chỉ sự tuyên bố trắng án và minh oan toàn diện.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The magistrate deemed the offense sufficiently severe to warrant a ___ (custody) sentence.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Custodial sentence là án tù giam (trái nghĩa với non-custodial sentence như phạt tiền hay lao động công ích).

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: In plea ___ (mitigate), the defense attorney highlighted the suspects voluntary surrender and genuine remorse.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Plea in mitigation là lời thỉnh cầu giảm nhẹ hình phạt trước tòa.

personaCards.meaningEn: A witness who willfully utters falsehoods under sworn oath in court.
personaCards.meaningVi: Kẻ khai man, nhân chứng làm chứng dối trước tòa.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A scrupulously truthful and incorruptible witness.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Perjurer weaves a fabricated alibi under sworn oath!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Đối lập trực diện với kẻ khai man dối trá (perjurer) là nhân chứng trung thực không thể lay chuyển (veracious witness).

personaCards.meaningEn: Shockingly atrocious, reprehensible, and wicked beyond imagination.
personaCards.meaningVi: Tội ác tày đình, man rợ và ghê rợn khôn cùng.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Excusable, pardonable, and minor in moral consequence.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Abyssal Malice strikes with an unforgivable and premeditated crime!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Heinous (tội ác dã man không thể dung thứ) bị hóa giải bởi venial (lỗi lầm nhỏ nhặt, dễ tha thứ).

personaCards.meaningEn: An incorrigible habitual criminal constantly relapsing into lawbreaking.
personaCards.meaningVi: Tội phạm tái phạm kinh niên, bất trị trước mọi hình phạt.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A fully rehabilitated person who has renounced all unlawful conduct.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Relentless Felon returns to the scene of crime, trapped in habitual cycle!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Kẻ tái phạm quen mui (recidivist) đối lập hoàn toàn với người công dân hoàn lương hướng thiện (reformed citizen).

personaCards.meaningEn: Completely cleared of guilt after suffering wrongful accusation.
personaCards.meaningVi: Người được minh oan và khôi phục toàn bộ danh dự sau biến cố oan khuất.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Deserving blame; guilty of committing the offense.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Vindicated Inmate presents indisputable DNA evidence shattering the prosecution case!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Được minh oan trắng án (exonerated) đối lập với có tội và phải chịu trách nhiệm hình sự (culpable).

personaCards.meaningEn: Conducted in absolute secrecy, especially for illicit or subversive aims.
personaCards.meaningVi: Bí mật, lén lút, hoạt động ngầm phi pháp.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Open, manifest, and plain to see without concealment.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Shadow Syndicate launders illicit cartel profits through offshore conduits!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Clandestine (ngấm ngầm, lén lút bất minh) bị khắc chế bởi overt (công khai, minh bạch trước thanh thiên bạch nhật).

personaCards.meaningEn: Surrendered by one sovereign territory to another to face criminal justice.
personaCards.meaningVi: Kẻ trốn chạy bị áp giải dẫn độ qua biên giới.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Officially granted sovereign diplomatic sanctuary against foreign prosecution.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Fugitive is seized at the international tarmac under an active Interpol Red Notice!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Bị dẫn độ về nước thụ án (extradited) đối nghịch với việc được cấp quyền tị nạn ngoại giao an toàn (granted asylum).

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: Because he had completed seven years of his term with exemplary behavior, the warden recommended him for early ___.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Parole là đặc xá tha tù sớm khi đang ngồi tù; Probation là chế độ quản chế án treo ngay từ đầu mà không phải vào tù.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: The fact that the perpetrator targeted a defenseless elderly victim served as a major ___ factor in the judge's sentencing.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Aggravating factor là tình tiết tăng nặng (làm tăng mức án); Extenuating factor là tình tiết giảm nhẹ.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: Following months of grand jury hearings, the federal court handed down a scathing 40-count ___ against the corrupt mayor.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Indictment là bản cáo trạng truy tố ban đầu; Verdict là phán quyết cuối cùng có tội hay vô tội sau phiên xử.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: Because the driver caused the fatal collision through reckless negligence rather than premeditated intent, he was charged with ___.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Manslaughter là tội ngộ sát (vô ý làm chết người do bất cẩn); Homicide là thuật ngữ chung chỉ hành vi giết người.

narrativeChronicle.title: The Trial of the Shadow Ledger
narrativeChronicle.subtitleVi: Vụ Án Cuốn Sổ Cái Trong Bóng Tối
narrativeChronicle.settingDescription: The Old Bailey Central Criminal Court. Heavy oak paneling echoes as a high-stakes embezzlement trial takes an unprecedented dramatic turn.

segments.promptTextBefore: The proceedings came to an abrupt halt. When it was revealed that the chief prosecution witness had committed blatant perjury, the entire trial

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The judge throws his hands up in dismay as the prosecution case crumbles beyond salvage.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: A trial collapses nghĩa là một phiên tòa bị đổ vỡ hoàn toàn do nhân chứng chủ chốt mất uy tín.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You try to extradite the courtroom itself to another country, leaving the bailiff completely bewildered.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Extradite là dẫn độ người đào tẩu, không thể dùng cho một phiên xét xử.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Incarcerating an abstract legal event causes the court stenographer to stop typing in protest.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Incarcerate chỉ áp dụng cho người (bỏ tù ai đó), không thể dùng cho vụ án.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Only higher appellate courts can quash verdicts after conviction; a live trial simply collapses.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Quash dùng cho phán quyết (verdict/conviction), không dùng cho tiến trình phiên tòa (trial).

segments.promptTextBefore: 'My client only diverted company funds because his family was held at gunpoint,' Sterling argued. 'These undeniable
segments.promptTextAfter: circumstances warrant the dismissal of all criminal intent.'

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The courtroom nods in sympathy; the severity of the charge is dramatically lowered.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Extenuating circumstances là tình tiết giảm nhẹ mang tính chuẩn mực trong tố tụng C2.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You plead that your client committed heinous circumstances, instantly convincing the judge to give him life in prison!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Heinous mang nghĩa tàn độc ghê tởm, dùng thế này là tự kết án tử thân chủ!

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Claiming clandestine circumstances makes your client sound like a shadowy spy rather than a victim of extortion.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Clandestine chỉ hành vi ngấm ngầm bất minh, không mang nghĩa pháp lý giảm nhẹ.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Describing an armed kidnapping as nominal circumstances causes the jury to question your sanity.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Nominal nghĩa là danh nghĩa/không đáng kể, không phù hợp ngữ cảnh cứu mạng gia đình.

segments.promptTextBefore: The forensic lab released its ballistics report. 'The recovered slug confirms the defendant never discharged the weapon, which completely
segments.promptTextAfter: him of the attempted murder charge.'

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The defendant bursts into tears as the murder charge is formally struck from the record.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Exonerate nghĩa là minh oan và xóa bỏ hoàn toàn tội danh hình sự.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You claim the clean forensic report incriminates him, causing the bailiff to handcuff him right there on the spot!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Incriminate là buộc tội làm cho có tội, trái ngược hoàn toàn với exonerate.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: A ballistic bullet cannot subpoena a person into court; bullets do not have judicial stamps.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Subpoena là tống đạt trát đòi hầu tòa, không dùng cho kết quả chứng cứ vật chứng.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You cannot parole someone who has not yet been convicted or served a single day of prison sentence.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Parole là đặc xá khi đang ngồi tù, không phải hành vi minh oan tại tòa.

segments.promptTextBefore: Justice having been restored, the High Court moved to officially
segments.promptTextAfter: the previous wrongful conviction and awarded full statutory restitution.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The magistrate strikes the gavel; the wrongful indictment is erased forever from British legal history.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Quash a conviction/verdict là thuật ngữ chuẩn mực về việc hủy bỏ bản án sai lệch.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Upholding the wrongful conviction sends an innocent man straight back to prison despite forensic proof!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Uphold là giữ nguyên bản án cũ, trái ngược với mục đích minh oan phục hồi danh dự.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Saying the High Court flouted the conviction makes the judges sound like lawless anarchists.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Flout mang nghĩa coi thường, khinh nhờn pháp luật, không phải động từ tư pháp chính quy.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You cannot incur a conviction like an unwanted bank fee.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Incur là gánh chịu nợ nần/chi phí, không áp dụng cho việc xử lý phán quyết.
